assignmentDocumentFeedback.condition: Split feedback that reconstructs graded performance from ordinary coursework feedback before assigning the four-year grade-book or one-year coursework series.

assignmentDrafts.condition: Use the 366-day no-earlier-than guardrail after academic-term end and preserve the student export, dispute, access-request, and legal-hold overrides.

assignmentFormSubmissions.condition: Split graded, ungraded, and research-routed submissions so grade-book, coursework, and IRB obligations cannot overwrite one another.

auditEvents.condition: Separate FERPA disclosures, disposition logs, security events, governance approvals, and transitory telemetry or apply the longest authorized series.

authIdentities.condition: Add status-aware account triggers, verified session revocation, retained-record pseudonymization, and an institutional access-record designation.

authProviderLogs.condition: Approve the current provider TTL, export and legal-hold path, residual-copy statement, and deletion-verification procedure.

authSessions.condition: Delete after expiry or revocation, keep access tokens short-lived, and retain only separately classified security events needed for an active incident.

billingCustomers.condition: Use 1096 days after the close of the fiscal year containing final activity, or a longer tax, audit, refund, chargeback, or litigation period.

billingSubscriptions.condition: Use 1096 days after the close of the fiscal year containing cancellation or final activity and preserve linked accounting evidence.

blackboardGradeExportSnapshots.condition: Complete the Blackboard round trip and obtain written confirmation that the snapshot is not the permanent original grade sheet.

blackboardIdentityMappings.condition: Use 731 days after supersession or access termination and retain longer only for an active security incident or access investigation.

blackboardProviderCopies.condition: Complete the institutional Blackboard archive, export, deletion, residual-copy, and confirmation review.

courseCommunicationPreferences.condition: Use 731 days after supersession or relationship termination while retaining separately required consent and accessibility preference evidence.

courseCommunicationReads.condition: Use 366 days after term end or message disposition and prohibit read-state from serving as official attendance or academic-action evidence.

courseLessonProgress.condition: Use 1827 days after graduation or last attendance and keep transcript or permanent achievement records in their separately designated system.

courseMemberships.condition: Use 1827 days after the institution-defined academic-year end and reconcile the official class roll before disposition.

courseProgress.condition: Use 1827 days after graduation or last attendance and exclude permanent transcript outcomes from this convenience copy.

educatorVerificationRequests.condition: Use 731 days after final disposition, minimize identity evidence after verification, and preserve complaint or fraud-investigation holds.

fileDeletionRequests.condition: Use 3653 days after final disposition or archival transfer and include the required record series, authorization, method, date, and outcome.

filePreviews.condition: Delete within seven days of source deletion, expiry, or replacement; a preview inherits every source hold and access restriction until deletion.

gradeShareLinks.condition: Use 731 days after revocation or expiry while keeping the FERPA disclosure record for as long as the underlying education record exists.

identityOnboardingRequests.condition: Use 731 days after final disposition and route approved identities into the separate status-aware account lifecycle.

institutionAccessApplications.condition: Use 731 days after final disposition and redact verification evidence that is no longer required.

institutionAffiliations.condition: Split student, employee, contractor, guest, and publisher affiliations and assign each record series and termination trigger independently.

institutionMemberships.condition: Split student academic membership from employee, contractor, and community membership before disposition.

institutionTransferRequests.condition: Use 1827 days after final transfer disposition or graduation or last attendance, whichever occurs later.

learningMessages.condition: Classify routine course, assessed, accommodation, grievance, research, safety, and legal messages when created.

learningResources.condition: Require resource type, owner, student/professor authorship, license, publication state, official-copy role, and archival-review metadata.

learningSystemIdentifiers.condition: Use 731 days after supersession or termination and require verified deprovisioning in every connected system.

legalHoldFiles.condition: Require underlying record classification, written counsel release, access controls, and records-authorized post-release disposition.

linkPreviews.condition: Delete within seven days, prohibit private or sensitive-source snapshots, and inherit the source hold until the preview is removed.

ltiContextMemberships.condition: Use 1827 days after academic-year end and reconcile context membership with the institution's official class roll.

ltiGradeSyncEvents.condition: Designate the original grade sheet, distinguish reconciliation telemetry from grade-book evidence, and preserve unresolved grade disputes.

ltiLaunchSessions.condition: Delete within 30 days of expiry or revocation and retain only separately classified incident evidence.

ltiProviderCopies.condition: Inventory every LTI provider's DPA, purpose, data elements, retention, export, deletion, and residual-copy behavior.

ltiUserMappings.condition: Use 731 days after supersession or access termination and verify deletion in both upstream and downstream mappings.

processingJobs.condition: Delete within 30 days after terminal status and ensure queues, retries, dead letters, and worker logs contain no unclassified payload copies.

profile.condition: Separate identity, directory, academic-reference, public-profile, and commercial fields and design status-aware pseudonymization.

providerBackups.condition: Apply a seven-day rolling database-backup minimum for the verified staging plan, document Storage separately, and reverify provider configuration quarterly.

publicationEntitlements.condition: Split free academic access, purchase, rental, refund, chargeback, and continuing-access entitlements before assigning financial retention.

readingAnnotations.condition: Split private notes, professor-visible assessed annotations, accessibility notes, and research measures and provide an export path.

secureFiles.condition: Reject unclassified production uploads and require every object to inherit an owner, record series, trigger, hold, and archival rule.

storageDeliveryCaches.condition: Purge within one day of origin deletion or replacement and verify private caching, signed-URL expiry, and CDN invalidation.

storageObjectVersions.condition: Bind each version to the source series, trigger, owner, legal hold, archival status, and verified byte-deletion outcome.

stripeWebhookPayloads.condition: Delete the payload within 30 days after signature verification and reconciliation, while retaining normalized accounting, tax, refund, and dispute evidence separately.

studentDataSubjectRequestItems.condition: Use 3653 days after final parent-request disposition and preserve linked correction statements and disclosure records for the life of the underlying record.

studentDataSubjectRequests.condition: Use 3653 days after final disposition and preserve identity verification, response timing, authorization, exceptions, and final outcome.

studentEducationPath.condition: Split temporary planning, five-year advisement/progress, and permanent degree-plan or transcript-equivalent outcomes.

studentEnrollmentRequests.condition: Use 1827 days after final decision or graduation or last attendance, whichever is later, and document the longer treatment of never-enrolled requests.

studentGrades.condition: Obtain the Registrar's written designation of EdNotebook as permanent original grade sheet, four-year grade book, or governed convenience copy.

studentGroupMemberships.condition: Split assessed academic groups, ordinary course groups, optional social groups, and official student-organization memberships.

studentGroups.condition: Split disposable course structures from official student-organization and historically significant group records.

studentLearningRecords.condition: Separate permanent achievement, five-year academic progress, four-year grade-book evidence, one-year coursework, and IRB-governed research measures.

studentPosts.condition: Split public/social posts, assessed course discussions, moderation evidence, grievances, and research-routed posts.

studentPublicProfile.condition: Implement institution-defined directory fields, annual notice, opt-out enforcement, audience controls, and status-aware removal.

studentRosterEntries.condition: Use 1827 days after academic-year end and reconcile with the institution-designated class roll before disposition.

unlinkedPortalInterestSubmissions.condition: Delete within 30 days after response, withdrawal, or abandonment and maintain a minimal suppression mechanism only when lawfully required.

uploadQuotaReservations.condition: Delete within one day after expiry, consumption, or cancellation and reconcile abandoned multipart uploads without retaining file contents.

userAuthoredProfessorPublisherContent.condition: Approve author rights, license, withdrawal, edition/version, archive, purchased-access survival, and embedded learner-data rules.

userEntitlements.condition: Split academic membership, universal free course, public-free, purchase, rental, refund, and continuing or perpetual access.

userFeaturePolicies.condition: Use 731 days after supersession or access termination and retain the linked access-decision audit record under its separately approved series.
